defaults.instructions:
1. This is a video series that follows a group of friends/content creators competitive Fantasy Football league. The league takes place during an individual NFL season. There is a playoff tournament at the end of each "season", ultimately resulting in a championship winner. There is also an Ultimate Loser of each season, who faces a special punishment before the start of the following season. Each new season starts fresh, coinciding with the start of the next NFL season. The inaugural season took place during the 2024-25 NFL season.
2. Reference a generic Fantasy Football PPR ruleset to understand how the game is played.
3. The narrative importance should be placed primarily on the "Team Owners" rather than the NFL athletes. For example, if noting that NFL athlete Puka Nacua is injured during Week 1, it is important to note who is the Team Owner with Puka Nacua on their team.
4. Team names (e.g. "StevenSwagal") may change week-to-week but Team Owner (e.g. "Tom") should remain static. Therefore, it is best to use the Team Owner name rather than the Team name in all notes.
5. Track as many details of who wins head-to-head matchups (including the score) each week, but note that the full details of every matchup are not always available for a given week due to how the videos are selectively edited.
6. Always make note of mentioned injuries, trades, and waiver wire actions.
7. Be concise in the note-taking; wordiness is not a virtue.
8. Make note of any "items requiring review" for each episode so that the human (me) can review your uncertainties and potentially add more guidance.
9. YouTube transcripts can be used as a supplement but note that they are not 100% accurate. If ever noticing a discrepancy between transcripted text and what appears on-screen, defer to on-screen content.

events.summary: Avery won the 2024 Flock League championship over Thomas. A later championship display showed Thomas’s stated team name, “Peaked In Knockout,” losing 109.38–166.38, although the winning-side label was unreadable.

facts.name: championship result
facts.value: Avery defeated Thomas

facts.name: displayed championship score
facts.value: Peaked In Knockout 109.38, unidentified opponent 166.38

facts.name: team-name linkage
facts.value: Thomas said he was changing his team name to Peaked In Knockout earlier in the episode

evidence.details: Thomas says Avery delivered and won the championship.
The season-conclusion narration explicitly identifies Avery as the 2024 Flock League champion.
Championship scoreboard shows Peaked In Knockout losing 109.38–166.38; the opponent text is not readable.

events.summary: Zach defeated Mason 217.58–149.08 in the Week 17 third-place game.

facts.name: round
facts.value: Third-place game

evidence.details: Zach says he took down Mason in the third-place game; the matchup display shows 217.58–149.08.

facts.name: round
facts.value: Toilet Bowl / last-place matchup

facts.name: margin of victory
facts.value: 15 points

facts.name: final score
facts.value: Not established

Earlier matchup display identifies the Toilet Bowl as Bush versus Nathan and shows it in progress.

events.summary: Nathan was described as the league’s “12th best team” and depicted with a toilet seat and turkey costume.

facts.name: season finish description
facts.value: 12th best team in the Flock League

facts.value: Toilet seat and turkey costume

facts.value: Not explicitly stated

Nathan is shown with a turkey costume, and commentary contrasts Avery’s championship items with Nathan’s toilet seat and turkey head.

events.summary: Bush sat Patrick Mahomes and started Anthony Richardson at quarterback in the Toilet Bowl.

facts.name: Anthony Richardson availability context
facts.value: Commentary said he was questionable and later had not practiced that week

evidence.details: Bush says he sat Mahomes; the visible lineup lists Anthony Richardson at QB, and Mahomes is shown with 26.00 points.

events.summary: Bush started Aaron Rodgers at quarterback after the quarterback availability issues; Rodgers scored 2.48 fantasy points.

facts.name: identity caveat
facts.value: Later commentary calls the manager Cory, while earlier matchup evidence identifies Bush; whether Cory is an alias is unresolved.

evidence.details: Narration says Bush was forced to start Rodgers, and the visible lineup lists Rodgers with 2.48 points.
Bush says he had been blocked at quarterback and had to play Aaron Rodgers.

events.summary: Nathan made a series of quarterback free-agent transactions, adding Justin Herbert, Drake Maye, and Matthew Stafford; the visible log also shows the associated drops.

facts.name: visible transactions
facts.value: Added Justin Herbert/dropped Russell Wilson; added Drake Maye/dropped Israel Abanikanda; added Matthew Stafford/dropped Drake Maye; added Drake Maye/dropped Romeo Doubs

evidence.details: The transaction log labels the moves as made by NathanSchmidt and lists the adds and drops.

events.summary: Thomas entered the championship with a depleted running-back group: Chuba Hubbard was on IR; Alvin Kamara and David Montgomery were out; and Jerome Ford was questionable.

facts.name: visible statuses
facts.value: Hubbard IR; Kamara OUT; Montgomery OUT; Ford QUES

facts.name: fantasy impact
facts.value: Thomas said he was struggling to fill his championship lineup

evidence.details: Thomas says Hubbard was placed on IR and Kamara was declared out; on-screen roster cards show their statuses.
Thomas names Kamara, Hubbard, Montgomery, and Ford as losses; the roster graphic shows Ford questionable, Kamara and Montgomery out, and Hubbard on IR.
